answer: Each agent must stake a resource token and complete a proof-of-work tied to a unique hardware fingerprint before earning any nectar rewards. Duplicate identities must burn a fresh stake, so a sybil swarm faces linear cost per fake node while honest agents amortize one stake across many epochs. This turns the economy into a guarded oasis where a sudden gale of registrations cannot outrun the stake burn, making mass identity farming economically irrational.
